title: Benchmark Profiling: Mechanistic Diagnosis of LLM Benchmarks

live_model.evidence: Sec 5 (Diagnostic Datasets): "These datasets were synthetically generated using the o4-mini-2025-04-16 API via carefully crafted few-shot prompting strategies tailored to each ability."

prompt.location: Appendix B (generation prompts and examples for each ability dataset)
prompt.note: Prompts are for dataset generation, not for a measured task performed by o4-mini itself.

claim.metric: none for o4-mini (used only to synthesize the 10 diagnostic MCQ datasets; the measured subjects are Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B)

data.source: 10 synthetic diagnostic MCQ datasets (2000 items each, 20,000 total), generated by the authors; standard suite of 10 external LLM benchmarks also used for the main analysis

notes: o4-mini-2025-04-16 is purely a synthetic-data generator here; no accuracy/quality number is reported for o4-mini's own generations (only downstream validation of the resulting datasets against target abilities, Sec. 6.1, applied to the datasets, not to o4-mini).
